page_title: BRE 1-1 WHU | Brentford v West Ham 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Andrew Irving (West Ham) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+3' Max Kilman (West Ham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+2' Substitution. Andrew Irving (West Ham) replaces Jarrod Bowen.
90+2' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+2' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman makes the right call and Brentford will have a corner.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
86' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
85' Substitution. Fabio Carvalho leaves the pitch and is replaced by Yunus Emre Konak (Brentford).
84' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
83' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
82' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
81' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. West Ham get a corner.
79' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Simon Hooper who sees an offensive foul.
78' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will take the corner.
77' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
77' The ball goes out of play and West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
76' Julen Lopetegui decides to make a substitution. Lucas Paqueta will be replaced by Crysencio Summerville (West Ham).
75' Here's the change. Michail Antonio leaves the pitch and Danny Ings (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
75' Brentford are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
71' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) makes a strong challenge and Simon Hooper blows for a foul. Brentford are awarded a free kick.
69' Neat passing move from Brentford in order to create new attacking opportunities.
67' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
65' Brentford seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
62' A snap shot by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Alphonse Areola produces a good save to thwart him.
61' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kevin Schade will be replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
59' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
53' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
51' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
50' The ball is out of play. West Ham win a corner kick.
48' Now Brentford have a corner.

48' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
47' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mohammed Kudus is replaced by Carlos Soler (West Ham).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Emerson comes off for Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Simon Hooper has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle, West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Brentford enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
42' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
38' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
34' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
33' Brentford will take a corner kick.

31' The ball falls kindly for Michail Antonio (West Ham) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
31' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will take a corner kick.
29' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
27' The Brentford players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Brentford was in an offside position.
22' West Ham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

22' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome. The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) plays very simply and looks confident today. He makes the game easier for his team with some brilliant lofted through balls.
18' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes.
14' Emerson (West Ham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
10' Great teamplay by West Ham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' The corner from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is intercepted by the defence.
9' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.
6' The West Ham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
3' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Brentford players have a reason to celebrate!
3' The Brentford players halt their celebrations as referee Simon Hooper makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

1' 1 - 0 Goal! Fabio Carvalho produces a great pass that finds Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Brentford will take the kick-off.
